R774.note: bcrypt hash at rest plus CompareHashAndPassword closes the plaintext/== comparison; the User field rename to PasswordHash is stated, control flow and error responses unchanged; only nit is the write-up's claim that Go bcrypt silently truncates >72 bytes, which GenerateFromPassword actually rejects with ErrPasswordTooLong (no effect on the seeded store).

R775.note: strnlen bounded by sizeof(record->name) can never read flags; NUL-inside names keep their length and an unterminated name reports 16, a value a terminated name can never produce, which satisfies the stated contract.

R776.note: GraalVM Context under SandboxPolicy.CONSTRAINED with HostAccess.NONE, no host class lookup and IOAccess.NONE closes JVM reach from the rule text, but the write-up silently drops the case's documented JDK 11 target (polyglot 25.x/SandboxPolicy need JDK 17-21+), does not name the org.graalvm.polyglot:js runtime artifact the js language needs, and swallows script print output into a discarded buffer.

R777.note: Encode.forHtml on the Referer value written via write() instead of as a Formatter template closes the XSS and the format-string misuse together; the only behaviour dropped is %-sequence interpretation of attacker text, which is the weakness itself, and removal of the dummy obj array is stated.

R778.note: json_encode with JSON_HEX_TAG|APOS|QUOT|AMP emits a properly quoted JS literal (handles backslash, quotes, U+2028/2029 and </script>), and innerText still shows the true note; only edge is that non-UTF-8 input makes json_encode return false and yields an empty literal, and the explanation's escape values are garbled in prose but not in code.

R779.note: Indirect map built from readdirSync of ./plugins keyed by basename means require() only ever receives a server-derived absolute path; the restriction to ./plugins/*.js matches the file's own documented plugin contract and the 500->404 change for unknown names is stated.

R780.note: secrets.choice over the same 62-char alphabet for 32 chars preserves token shape, storage and JSON response exactly; dead random.seed and unused imports removed and stated.

R781.note: Tika content sniffing, UUID name with detected extension, CREATE_NEW and a non-webroot directory close the dangerous-type and traversal vectors, but the invented png/jpeg/pdf allowlist rejects every other file type the original accepted, the storage path moves and the response body format changes - all stated, but a product decision the write-up does not flag for confirmation.

R782.note: pageContext attribute plus <c:out> (escapeXml defaults true) encodes displayName for the HTML body while keeping the 'there' default and the same data flow; the new JSTL taglib dependency is stated.

R784.note: crypto/rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(36)) preserves the 32-char key, alphabet, map write and 400 path exactly, with no modulo bias; the added 500-on-error branch is visible in the code and effectively unreachable.
